names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 28 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Ιγνάτιος Επίσκοπος Ροστώβ», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 28. мај ст. ст., „Свети Игњатије епископ ростовски“ — Свети is not a rank, епископ is the `bishop` this corpus puts in `types` and the `Bishop` in `office`, and „ростовски“ is the see, which `office` and the display name both carry. Strip them and the bare personal name is left. **Measured**: `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Игњатије», so this is the first folder to hold it, although the corpus keeps a long column of Ignatii, none of them with an `sr` form. **Note the Serbian spelling**: «Игњатије» with the њ, where the Russian calendar writes «Игнатий» — the same name and not the same string, as with «Маркијан» against «Маркиан» on 25 May. The Greek form on this folder, «Ιγνάτιος», is the same bare name.

The heading of the calendar’s name link 905, «Святитель Игнатий Ростовский, епископ», with the rank word before the name and the office after it left off; the day’s own line gives the see in the genitive. `fk.mjs` returned NONE for «игнатии ростовскии» before the write, and the bare «Игнатий» was deliberately not stored, this corpus holding a great many of that name and this branch having written an `ignatius-markov` on this very day.

death.note: saint.gr's head line reads «Αγιος Ιγνατιος Επισκοπος Ροστωβ (; - 1288)», and the body repeats it: «Ποίμανε θεοφιλώς το ποίμνιό του για είκοσι έξι χρόνια και κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το 1288 μ.Χ.» It gives no year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 мая ст. ст. — «Свт. Игнатия , еп. Ростовского (1288).»

attestations.note: The identification is exact: the line gives the see this folder’s office already names and the year 1288 its `dates` already hold, and its Greek and Serbian rows keep him on the same Julian day. `dates` is unchanged. THE CALENDAR GIVES HIM NO LIFE PAGE AT ALL: his line carries a link to his name, 905, and none to a reading, and his whole content here is the two hymns the day page prints under his own name. HE IS THE THIRD OF THE THREE ROSTOV HIERARCHS this calendar sings together, and the day page prints FOUR company hymns beside his two: «Тропарь святителей Ростовских Леонтия, Исаии, Игнатия» (глас 4) and its «Кондак» (глас 8), which name the three, and «Тропарь святителям Ростовским» (глас 4) and its «Кондак» (глас 4), the first of which names six. NONE OF THE FOUR WAS COPIED, on the ruling the 15 May reader stated and queued: a hymn addressed to three saints or to six, sitting in one folder, tells the reader that the Church sings it to him. The 15 May page prints the same four under `isaiah-of-rostov` and they were refused there too. The third of the three, Leontius of Rostov, HAS NO FOLDER IN THIS CORPUS AT ALL, which is this branch’s 23 May finding. azbyka.ru was not read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Ιγνάτιος Επίσκοπος Ροστώβ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It sends the reader on to the synaxis of all the saints who shone in Rostov and Yaroslavl, which is a synaxis heading and not a folder. It prints no hymn.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 10.06.2026 (28. мај ст. ст.) — „Свети Игњатије епископ ростовски“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, on the same menologion 28/5 the Greek row already carries, and the Russian and Romanian rows are `undocumented`. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of the 23 to 28 May is. **`dates` UNTOUCHED AND CORROBORATED TO THE DAY.** „Представио се Господу 28. маја 1288. године“ is exactly the `death` of 1288 this folder holds off saint.gr, and **the day it gives is 28 May, which is the day this row is written on** — so a Russian hierarch’s repose and his feast fall together, unlike the eight-day gap on `nicetas-the-stylite-of-pereslavl` on 24 May. **There is no field for a day of death**, so it is in the prose. **The twenty-six years of his episcopate are a duration and are used for nothing**; they also corroborate saint.gr’s own twenty-six, so two books agree on the length and neither gives a year of birth, and none was derived. **THE WONDER IS MUCH FULLER HERE, AND THAT IS THE WHOLE VALUE OF THE ROW.** saint.gr says only that on the day of his funeral some of the faithful saw his honourable relic raise itself and bless them. **The Prologue says what they saw**: „видеше неки, како он уста из сандука и диже се на ваздуху изнад цркве, и са висине благослови људе и град, потом се поново врати у свој мртвачки сандук“ — that he rose out of the coffin and **lifted into the air above the church**, and **from on high blessed the people and the city**, and then **returned again into his coffin**. **The city blessed as well as the people, the height above the church and the return to the coffin are all new.** It also confirms that **many other wonders happened at his grave**, which is where this folder’s `wonderworker` comes from, and that **he governed the flock of Christ with great love and mercy**. `hierarch`, `bishop` and `wonderworker` are all three corroborated and **no type was added**. `office` untouched at `Bishop of Rostov`, which the heading says in its own words. **Nobody in the entry gains a row**, the entry naming no person at all besides him; `related` stays empty. No `locations`, although Rostov is named in the heading. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Благоверия просвещся учении,/ святительства прием паству/ и апостолов наследник быв,/ тем приял еси от Бога дар чудес, святителю отче Игнатие,/ моли Христа Бога,/ да спасет души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 мая ст. ст., «Тропарь святителя Игнатия, епископа Ростовского», глас 4 — proper to him, under his own name and his own see, as against the four company hymns the same page prints

english.text: Being enlightened by the teachings of right belief, thou didst receive a flock in the office of a hierarch and wast made an heir of the apostles; and thereby thou didst receive from God the gift of wonders, O hierarch and father Ignatius. Pray thou to Christ God, that he may save our souls.

hymns.text: Явися днесь пресветлая память твоя,/ святителю преблаженне Игнатие,/ в мире светло сияющи и являющи всем Божественное сияние.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 мая ст. ст., «Кондак святителя Игнатия, епископа Ростовского» — proper to him, under his own name and his own see. THE PAGE PRINTS NO TONE FOR THIS ONE, alone of the day's thirteen hymn blocks, so none is recorded here

english.text: Today thy most radiant memory has appeared, O most blessed hierarch Ignatius, shining brightly in the world and showing forth to all the divine radiance.
